mLocKeys.keySummary: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Killing an enemy restores <scaleLevel>@ChogathCarnivoreHeal@</scaleLevel> Health and <scaleLevel>@ChogathCarnivoreMana@</scaleLevel> Mana.

mBuff.mDescription:
FeastThis unit has grown larger, gaining @f1@ bonus Health.
  • Minions Chomped: @f2@
  • Pets Gobbled: @f3@
  • Monsters Eaten: @f4@
  • Dragons Consumed: @f5@
  • Epic Monsters Ingested: @f6@
  • Champions Devoured: @f7@
    • Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing <trueDamage>@RDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> to champions or <trueDamage>@RMonsterDamage@</trueDamage> to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain <healing>@RHealthPerStack@ max Health</healing>. Only @RMinionMaxStacks@ stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Current minion and non-epic jungle monster stacks: @f3@/@RMinionMaxStacks@
Cho'Gath gains bonus attack and Feast cast range based upon his stacks:
@AttackRangePerStack@ Attack Range per stack (max @MaxBonusAttackRange@).
@CastRangePerStack@ Cast Range per stack (max @MaxBonusCastRange@).

mLocKeys.keySummary: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cho'Gath roars, <status>Silencing</status> enemies for @Effect2Amount@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Rupture</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is flying through the air and can take no actions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies for @Effect5Amount@ second, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage>, and <status>Slowing</status> them by @Effect2Amount@% for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Cho'Gath's attacks release deadly spikes, dealing damage and slowing all enemy units in front of him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cho'Gath's next 3 Attacks launch spikes that deal <magicDamage>@FlatDamageCalc@ plus @MaxHealthPercentCalc@ of the target's max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slow</status> by @SlowAmountPercentage@%, decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Feast stacks increase the width of the spikes and the max Health damage by @FeastStackMultiplier@% per stack.
Percent Health damage against monsters is replaced with @ModifiedMonsterCap@.
